data.body: Constraint (outage on 2026-10-04): every SettingsConfigurationV2 section is deny_unknown_fields, so REMOVING a field bricks any profile that already persisted it. The native-ComfyUI task deleted ComfyUiConfigurationV2.bridgeServerId; profiles written by the earlier bridge build then failed `stored settings document is invalid: unknown field bridgeServerId`, so CanonicalDocuments::open failed and every command answered Err. The UI showed only "Chat projection unavailable" with no reason. Fixed by keeping the key readable and unrewritten: #[serde(default, skip_serializing)] bridge_server_id, plus two regression tests (runtime/comfyui/settings.rs, runtime/documents.rs). Rule for future edits: never drop a persisted Settings field; read it, ignore it, and let the next write drop it. Surfacing the startup error on that screen is still open.
